events.title: Will
events.description: Names children Joseph, Daniel, Hannah (wife of Mr Josiah Topping), deceased son Samuel's children, David, Ephraim and Nathan (executor); son-in-law Josiah Topping to sell two slaves, Gordg and Moll; the woman to choose her own master. [R4-S1]

bio: His will (Banta, [R4-S1]; recorded N.Y. Liber 7, folio 480) is the document that shows his daughter Hannah married Josiah Topping and had no daughter Jerusha. A humane touch: he asked that his enslaved woman 'may have Liberty to chuse her master when she is sold' and keep her clothes and box.
